title: Fixed Parallel Link and Calf Cuff Platform Stilt
description: One newly authored complete empty fixed platform-stilt exterior. A full elongated flat ground shoe supports two separated long parallel upright links through four transverse pivot appearances; the upper links carry a distinct raised full foot deck. A rear heel stop, two arching fixed foot bands, a long offset calf support and an open-front thick calf cuff complete the single device. This is not an old crutch with a step added: it has no hand grip or hand-rest shaft, and the whole ground-shoe to raised-foot-deck parallel-link topology is new. Nor is it the old central coil pogo with paired side pedals and handlebar: no central spring, plunger or hand mast is used. All geometry newly authored. One model zero scenes, four opaque PBR materials. Empty static entertainment-equipment appearance only; no person, fitted footwear, adjustment, linkage movement, balance, spring response, wearability, load, manufacturing, performance or safe use claim. Rigging animation interaction not made.
